brand.name: Suvi Interior
brand.location: Shop No. G2, Pandhari Mala, 273, Shree Kulswamini Business Centre, 10, Ambad-Uttam Nagar Road, Opp. Rajat Park, Nashik 422010
brand.ethos: A premium interior and furniture studio creating thoughtfully designed spaces with precision, functionality and timeless aesthetics.

typography.instructions_to_main_agent:
Never use Inter or Roboto for headings. Stacked headings like 'CRAFTED / FOR / MODERN LIVING' should use
tags and have very tight line-height. Import Google Fonts for Cormorant Garamond and Manrope in index.css. Use them explicitly via Tailwind classes or base styles.

colors.instructions_to_main_agent: Configure these exact hex codes in tailwind.config.js. Avoid standard bright Tailwind colors. Ensure high contrast ratio. Do not use generic full-screen gradients.

spacing_and_layout.padding: Generous. Standard section padding: py-24 md:py-32.
spacing_and_layout.borders: Thin, 1px solid borders for separators. Avoid border-radius where possible; use rounded-none or max rounded-sm for subtle edges.
spacing_and_layout.shadows: DO NOT USE typical drop shadows. Rely on thin borders and negative space.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento Tetris or asymmetrical editorial grids. Never fill 100% of the grid perfectly.
spacing_and_layout.instructions_to_main_agent: Avoid putting sections inside standard cards. Let elements sit directly on the background. Use thin 1px horizontal lines to separate services. Ensure container optical alignment.

motion_and_interactions.scrolling: Lenis smooth scrolling is MANDATORY. Use @studio-freight/react-lenis.
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal for H1 using framer-motion (overflow-hidden wrapper, translateY 100% to 0).
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveals: Use framer-motion 'whileInView' for subtle y-axis translates.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Subtle image parallax using useScroll and useTransform for hero/project images.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Images scale subtly on hover (scale-105 with duration-700 ease-out). Services list triggers image swap on hover.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: One very slow editorial marquee using react-fast-marquee.

components.header: Transparent header initially, transitioning to solid slightly blurred bg (#F7F5F0/90 backdrop-blur-md) on scroll. Left aligned wordmark, right aligned 'Start a Project'. Fullscreen elegant mobile menu overlay.
components.buttons: Minimal rectangular buttons. e.g. border border-primary px-6 py-3 uppercase tracking-widest text-xs hover:bg-primary hover:text-light transition-colors.
components.services_list: Editorial rows with large typography, separated by thin borders.
components.footer: Giant typography 'SUVI / INTERIOR'. Dark background (#181614). Thin borders for link separation.
components.projects_gallery: Masonry or asymmetrical grid. Image + text below. Use a lightbox.
components.instructions_to_main_agent: For React components, write .js or .jsx extensions. Do not use generic Shadcn cards for main layout blocks. DO NOT use complete transparent background in header if it overlaps content.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Stick to solid architectural tones.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but DO NOT rely on box shadows.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions to specific properties to avoid breaking Framer Motion transforms.
DO NOT center align the app container. Respect the natural reading flow.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
Ensure `tailwind.config.js` is updated with the custom fonts and color palette.
DO NOT use generic placeholder text. Use the actual brand info provided.
Use .js/.jsx files as requested by the environment constraints.
